dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: That's the life... Even taking the train feels so relaxing when one isn't heading back to HQ...

dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: Ah, right. You see, I am a field worker with the Royal Energy Commission, and I am responsible for looking into... well, you know, matters related to energy and all that across the different regions.

dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: I don't have to get to the office at a set hour, and most days, I don't have too much work piled on me either. I just have to get my field work done, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: Now look at the folks over at HQ. They are working shifts round the clock just to keep that Kresnik's Torch going. Barely even get a chance to catch their breath.

dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: But it has been a good while since I last went back to HQ myself. The last time I did, the guard nearly chased me off, thought I was some kind of imposter or something...

dialogues.speaker: Arzamasova
dialogues.text: Thank you. You have a pleasant journey too.
